note: What a server sends to open the run of units a client is about to be told about. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: botsOnOneSide
fields.note: How many bots play on side 100. A client adds it to that side's head count, which picks the table of spawn positions and facings it places champions by (CreateChampion's spawnIndex).

fields.name: botsOnTheOther
fields.note: The other. It shares the reading above.

fields.name: firstCount
fields.note: How many seats on side 100 nobody holds. Added to that side's players, it chooses the layout of the side's starting places.
